evidence: Suet. Ner. 2, of a beard’s colour (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From aes, bronze or copper; of things made of it, and of its colour (Lewis & Short).

evidence: Cato, Agr. 81: in aulam ahēneam aquae calidae plēnam

phrases.latin: simulācra duo aēnea ad Taenarum vīserentur, delphīnus vehēns et homō īnsidēns
phrases.english: two bronze statues could be seen at Taenarum, a dolphin carrying and a man riding

phrases.latin: Illud aēneum cum pistillō ejusdem metallī.
phrases.english: That bronze one, with the pestle of the same metal.

sources: Lewis & Short: aeneus · Lewis & Short: aheneus
